items.label: Breaking
items.text: Rapture countdown clock adds new feature: ‘auto-rollover’ for when the trumpet doesn’t cooperate.

items.label: Developing
items.text: Prophecy newsletter confirms Fourth Horseman is ‘likely inflation,’ but asks readers to pray before cancelling premium tier.

items.label: Report
items.text: Third Temple planning committee unveils ‘temporary sanctum’ concept; donors can sponsor the veil in monthly installments.

items.label: Watch
items.text: Blood moon spotted over suburban cul-de-sac; conference speakers reminding attendees it ‘definitely counts if you felt something.’

items.label: Update
items.text: Analyst re-runs ‘this generation’ calculations using New Testament units; arrives at ‘one to three more book releases.’

items.label: Developing
items.text: Local church urged to sell possessions ‘any day now,’ but keeps receipt just in case of tribulation refund policy.
